attchmntText: Bharti Airtel Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Bharti Airtel Limited published newspaper advertisements on November 14, 2026, regarding the claim of proceeds from fractional entitlements. These proceeds relate to the Scheme between Tata Teleservices Maharashtra Limited and Bharti Airtel Limited, effective July 1, 2019. Eligible shareholders of Tata Teleservices Maharashtra Limited are requested to claim unclaimed amounts by sending an application to KFin Technologies Limited on or before February 15, 2027. The required documents include Form ISR-1 and ISR-2, a self-attested PAN card copy, address proof, a cancelled cheque copy, and a Client Master List for DEMAT holdings. If no claim is received by February 15, 2027, the unclaimed amounts will be transferred to the Investor Education and Protection Fund Authority.

attchmntText: Bharti Airtel Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Bharti Airtel Limited filed the transcript of its earnings call for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026, held on November 6, 2026. Consolidated revenue was approximately Rs. 60,900 Crores, with consolidated EBITDAaL at about Rs. 31,500 Crores. Capex for the quarter was about Rs. 12,500 Crores. The company reported operating free cash flow of over Rs. 19,000 Crores. Net debt to EBITDAaL improved to about 0.70. Airtel Money Africa listed on the London Stock Exchange in October at a valuation of about $7 billion. India mobile added 0.7 million revenue-earning customers. Homes delivered net adds of 670,000. Airtel Business revenues were about Rs. 5,800 Crores.

attchmntText: Bharti Airtel Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Bharti Airtel Limited has disclosed its schedule for investor meetings under SEBI Listing Regulations. The company will participate in the CITIC CLSA India Forum on November 16, 2026, in Mumbai. This event includes group and one-on-one meetings. Additionally, Bharti Airtel will attend the Morgan Stanley Annual Asia Pacific Summit from November 18, 2026, to November 19, 2026, in Singapore. The company confirmed that no unpublished price sensitive information will be shared during these interactions. The schedule is subject to change due to exigencies on the part of investors or the company.
